spans.s:
mfn. (-घ्रः-घ्रा-घ्रं)
Quick, speedy.
m. (-घ्रः)
(In astronomy,) Parallax.
n. adv. (-घ्रं)
Quickly, swiftly.
E.
शिघ to smell, रक् aff. deriv. irr.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Going quick.
E.
शीघ्र, and ग who goes.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Going quick or expeditiously.
E.
शीघ्र quickly, and गामिन् who goes.

m. (-नः)
A dog.
E.
शीघ्र quickly, चेतन thinking, knowing.

m. (-न्मा)
A plant, (Cæsalpinia bonduccella.)
E.
शीघ्र quick, जन्मन् birth.

f. (-ता)
Quickness, speed.
E.
शीघ्र, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शीघ्रत्वं.

m. (-घी)
A good archer, a good shot.
E.
शीघ्र quick, and वेधिन् who pierces.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Becoming quick or expeditious.
E.
शीघ्र nominal verb to be quick, शानच् aff.

The fighting of cats.
E.
शीघ्र quick, and घ aff.
